answer: Each clone is one opal. oasis is the only registry binding key, endpoint and a cluster path, so twins collide. To stay live, an identity needs vouches spanning three separate branches each epoch; every branch vouches once per epoch, and one global sequencer orders all vouching so the kth vouch burns k spiral into the vouched record. Holding n opal needs 3n vouches, about (3n)^2/2 spiral per epoch, serialized, not lendable. It breaks if oasis dedups weakly, branches are rented in bulk, or spiral transfers.
